name: storytime-text
label: Storytime over satisfying B-roll (faceless split)
description: Original story (never scraped posts) told by VO over looping brand-owned satisfying B-roll, word-by-word captions on the seam, verdict question or Part 2 ending.

sync.broll: brand-owned satisfying loop (taping, protein pour, gym) fills one half for the whole piece
sync.music: none or very low so the VO dominates
sync.emotion_map: intrigue → indignation → suspense → shock → judgement urge
sync.transitions: none; cut the series at a cliffhanger

evidence: est. from public sources; calibrate with measured references
compliance_lock: health: fictional + educational, never first-person 'I was cured'
